objective: Add --help and composable four-language --lang greetings, include selected lang in CLI JSON, keep translations in src/lang.js and greet(name) backward compatible, and preserve unaffected behavior under the supplied compatibility and help-precedence answers.

requirements.text: Provide a help flag that emits usage successfully without requiring a name.

acceptance.text: --help and Ada --help each exit 0 with exactly USAGE plus newline on stdout and empty stderr.
--help --lang es --shout --json --repeat 2 exits 0 with exactly one plain usage line and no greeting; -- --help instead greets the literal name --help.

requirements.text: Select English, Spanish, French or German greetings while preserving one-argument greet behavior.

acceptance.text: Module tests assert greet('Ada') and greet('Ada','en') equal 'Hello, Ada!', with es/fr/de yielding 'Hola, Ada!', 'Bonjour, Ada!' and 'Hallo, Ada!'; translations reside in src/lang.js.
CLI cases for Ada and --lang en/es/fr/de Ada produce the matching greeting plus newline, exit 0 and empty stderr.

requirements.text: Reject missing or unsupported language values before greeting output, including when help is present.

acceptance.text: Separate CLI cases --lang, Ada --lang, --lang zz Ada, --lang '' Ada, --lang EN Ada, --lang constructor Ada, --lang --shout Ada, and --lang es Ada --lang zz produce exit 2, empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr.
--help --lang zz, --lang --help, --help --repeat 0, and --help --verbose each produce exit 2, empty stdout and exactly USAGE plus newline on stderr; help waives only the name requirement.

requirements.text: Compose language selection with shout, JSON and repetition.

acceptance.text: For each language, test all eight combinations of shout/json/repeat with repeat 2 when enabled; assert exact translated or uppercased output, one emission or two identical emissions, exit 0 and empty stderr. JSON objects contain exactly greeting and lang, including default en when --lang is absent.

Representative options before/after/around the name yield identical results; repeated valid --lang values use the last code; -- terminates option recognition. Repeated JSON round-trips quotes, backslashes, newline and tab in names with correct greeting and unchanged lowercase lang.

requirements.text: Preserve remaining behavior and working conventions within the approved scope.

acceptance.text: npm test passes with only existing assertions directly superseded by help recognition/output, usage, parser options and CLI JSON lang updated; every other regression assertion remains intact, including repeat validation and equals syntax, missing/empty names without help, unknown options, duplicate booleans, extra positionals, terminator handling, greet(name), shout, and one-argument toJson.

Read-only change review confirms implementation writes are confined to approved source/test paths; package.json, README.md, .github/** and .orchestrator/** are unchanged, no dependencies added, and src/lang.js contains translations.

decisions.title: Translation and greet interface
decisions.decision: T1 owns frozen GREETING_PREFIXES and isLanguage(code) in src/lang.js, plus greet(name, lang='en'). Preserve one-argument behavior, validate supported own keys, and default unsupported explicit module languages to RangeError.

decisions.title: Argument and usage interface
decisions.decision: T2 owns help/lang parser options, invalid-lang errors and exact usage: Usage: node bin/hello.js [--help] [--lang <code>] [--shout] [--json] [--repeat <n>] <name>. Default en; accept separated lowercase codes; validate every occurrence; last valid code wins; retain existing repeat and positional semantics.

decisions.title: Resolved help precedence
decisions.decision: Per supplied Q-202 answer, unknown options and invalid/missing option values fail even with --help. Help waives only name validation and emits usage once.

decisions.title: Serialization and process effects
decisions.decision: T2 extends toJson with optional lang while preserving one-argument output. CLI always supplies lang, transforms only greeting text and retains loop-based repetition. Help bypasses greeting formatting and repetition.

decisions.title: Resolved compatibility and verification boundary
decisions.decision: Per supplied Q-201 answer, update only directly superseded assertions and preserve every other regression assertion. Use existing node:test/spawnSync conventions and propose npm test for later approval. No dependencies, README/workflow/config edits, browser work or remote operations; this attempt executes no project code.

milestones.title: Translation module and backward-compatible greet interface reviewed with passing unit evidence; CLI, parser and formatter behavior unchanged.
Help and language behavior integrated under resolved answers; all development criteria have passing mapped evidence and scope review.
